title: SignalCount: Approximate Counts with Structured and Semantic Predicates in Seconds
abstract: arXiv:2611.30779v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Many applications store records with structured columns and a text document, and ask how many records in a filtered set meet a criterion that only a reader of the text can judge, such as "How many patients with type 2 diabetes, aged 40 to 70, stopped metformin because their blood sugar stayed high?" An interactive application needs this count in seconds, as the user types the criterion, to decide whether the matching set is worth materializing with a batch pipeline in which an LLM judges the records. Prior approximate query processing over such semantic predicates has an expensive model, the oracle, label a sample at query time, so every query waits for the oracle. We present SignalCount, a production system that answers COUNT queries with structured and semantic predicates and calls no oracle at query time, even for ad-hoc criteria. translated_title: SignalCount：在数秒内基于结构化与语义谓词进行近似计数
translated_abstract: 许多应用程序存储的记录既包含结构化列又包含文本文档，并且需要查询过滤后集合中有多少条记录满足只有阅读文本才能判断的条件，例如“有多少年龄在40到70岁之间的2型糖尿病患者因为血糖持续偏高而停用了二甲双胍？”交互式应用需要在用户输入查询条件的数秒内得到该计数，以判断匹配的记录集是否值得通过一个由LLM评判记录的批处理流水线来物化。以往针对此类语义谓词的近似查询处理需要在查询时让一个昂贵的模型（即oracle）对样本进行标注，因此每次查询都必须等待oracle。我们提出了SignalCount，这是一个生产系统，能够回答同时包含结构化与语义谓词的COUNT查询，并且在查询时无需调用oracle，即使对于临时指定的查询条件也是如此。它的oracle就是生产环境中的LLM评判器，而该评判器所记录的判定结果会在离线阶段校准快速分类器……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: SignalCount是一个生产级系统，它利用生产环境LLM评判器的历史判定日志在离线阶段校准快速分类器，从而在数秒内回答同时包含结构化与语义谓词的COUNT查询，且查询时完全无需调用昂贵的oracle模型。
en_tdlr: SignalCount is a production system that answers COUNT queries combining structured and semantic predicates in seconds without calling an expensive oracle at query time, by using a production LLM judge's logged verdicts to offline-calibrate fast classifiers.
